skip_reason: The 'sunday' skill requires an unavoidable authenticated/stateful network dependency. Specifically: (1) A real account must be created at the external service 'sunday.ravi.app'; (2) `sunday auth login` requires a browser-based OAuth flow; (3) The E2E encryption vault depends on a PIN-derived key stored in ~/.sunday/config.json that is tied to the real external server. All core skill features (inbox, passwords, identity) require this live authenticated session. There is no documented local-only or offline mode, and the mock server pattern cannot replicate the proprietary encryption protocol or the email infrastructure. This hits the 'Authenticated/Stateful Network: Requires real API keys, logins, or OAuth' ban.
